decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Construction Method Statement, Design & Access/ Planning Statement, Flood Risk Assessment, 350/001, 350/002, 350/010, 350/011, 350/012, 350/013, 350/015 Received: 07 October 2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall only be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Method Statement and Flood Risk Assessment provided with the application and the basement shall not be occupied until all the measures are implemented.

Condition : 5 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 0800 to 1800 on Mondays to Friday and 0800 to 1300 on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The basement shall at no time be used or occupied as a separate dwelling independent of the main house and shall not be used as sleeping accommodation.
description: Extension to basement with the addition of a front light well
